finding: Price values contained currency symbols and separators
decision: Converted prices to numeric INR; kept original text

finding: RAM and storage were unavailable in some listings
decision: Extracted RAM and storage independently; kept unknowns as NaN

finding: 112 listings had RAM below 1 GB; seven unique records with missing RAM were manually reviewed: three classified as feature phones and four as smartphones
decision: Applied a RAM/specification-based heuristic with manual model-level review. The observed price separation supports the exploratory analysis but does not independently validate the feature-phone definition.

finding: Duplicate OPPO F35 Pro listing confirmed
decision: Removed one duplicate

finding: 146 OS-family values missing; 147 OS versions missing
decision: Recognized family without requiring version; retained unknowns

finding: 67 smartphones met the defined legacy-version thresholds
decision: Flagged Android <= 11 and iOS <= 14 without deleting records

finding: 838 smartphones included in the main analysis
decision: Excluded feature phones and explicitly legacy smartphones

finding: 807 wattages known; 73 fast-charging mentions without wattage; 140 without a fast-charging mention
decision: Kept unknown wattage as NaN; retained charging status

finding: Missing screen size: 1; missing resolution: 15; missing Hz: 214
decision: Kept unlisted specifications as NaN; did not assume 60 Hz

finding: Missing rear-main MP: 55; rear-camera count: 19; front MP: 127
decision: Kept unavailable values as NaN; explicit No Rear Camera remains zero

finding: Missing processor names: 107; CPU cores: 112; CPU speed: 169
decision: Used unclassified as a fallback only when processor text was missing; converted MHz to GHz and mapped Nine Core to 9

finding: Recovered 22 chip names from unclassified
decision: Kept the original processor text as the first source

finding: Unsupported: 225; supported: 521; unknown: 274
decision: Created a nullable Boolean; kept missing descriptions unknown

finding: Collection date: 2026-10-14
decision: Added collection date from scraper metadata for future price tracking

finding: Each SIM feature flag has 10 missing values
decision: Used NA where SIM text is absent; did not infer unsupported features

finding: Brand derived from the first word of model names
decision: Standardized casing using the most common spelling per group

finding: 38 listings contained Foldable Display
decision: Created a foldable flag without deleting records

finding: Processor speeds were listed in MHz as well as GHz
decision: Converted MHz to GHz by dividing by 1000

finding: Found spelling variants Samaung and Moto
decision: Standardized them to Samsung and Motorola

finding: 39 listings produced derived CPU speeds below 0.1 GHz
decision: Set these speeds to NaN pending source verification
